baseline.policy: All entries below existed before Prompt 14 execution. Prompt 14 files are excluded and listed under filesChanged.

performedStages: Recorded HEAD and dirty working-tree hashes without restoring or deleting existing work.
Audited world, simulation, command, atomic commit, projection, incremental map, and persistence contracts.
Measured seed country/color data and checked current boundary/polygon geometry and coverage.

findings: Mutable TerritoryEntity still owns Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry and ownerCountryId.
TerritoryEntity has no sourceCountryId or controllerCountryId.
CountryEntity has no authoritative mapColor field; seed color remains metadata-sidecar data.
WorldStateV2 has no immutable catalog reference.

simulation.finding: No territorial-control or country-presentation authority collections exist yet.

command.finding: Existing V2 territory commands can carry geometry; Prompt 14 must not expand one requested operation into one command per territory.

atomicCommit.finding: World patches and paired world/simulation turn snapshots already provide stale checks, rollback on publication failure, history, undo, and redo seams.

mapIncrementalAdapter.finding: Normal revisions use GeoJSONSource.updateData for changed IDs; setData is limited to initial source attachment and explicit resynchronization.

projection.finding: Projection is WorldStateV2-based and will require catalog-backed geometry without bypassing the incremental adapter.

persistence.finding: Canonical serialization/restore helpers exist, but production UI has no localStorage/sessionStorage persistence path; refresh still boots the canonical seed.

documentDifferences: The repository does contain a worldwide raw Admin-1 polygon input, not only CHN/USA fixtures.
The browser-facing Admin-1 boundary asset is MultiLineString-only and cannot serve as authoritative territory geometry.
The raw source attribution names Natural Earth and its public-domain terms but does not pin an upstream release or commit.
Seed map colors are lowercase #rrggbb metadata values, not canonical uppercase WorldState values.
nextStage: 14-2 source, generation, and delivery hard gate
